datasets.title: Raw Intake Observation Envelopes
datasets.purpose: Staged representation of all physical Lab 2 observation records, preserving source identity, source row, source hash, parse status, and raw payload for complete accounting and provenance.

columns.name: record_id
columns.meaning: Logical record identifier supplied by the source when available.

columns.name: sensor_id
columns.meaning: Identifier of the source sensor.

columns.name: event_time
columns.meaning: Original event timestamp text from the source prior to normalization.

columns.name: ingest_time
columns.meaning: Original ingestion timestamp text from the source prior to normalization.

columns.name: reading
columns.meaning: Original source reading prior to numeric parsing and validation.

columns.name: unit
columns.meaning: Original measurement unit supplied by the source.

columns.name: operator_email
columns.meaning: Operator email field supplied by the synthetic source dataset.

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: S3 object location of the original source record.

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: Physical row number within the source object.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the original source object.

columns.name: parse_ok
columns.meaning: Indicates whether the source record was parsed successfully.

columns.name: raw_payload
columns.meaning: Preserved raw representation of the physical source record.

datasets.title: Curation Quarantine Dataset
datasets.purpose: Restricted curation output containing physical records rejected during parsing, key validation, ingest validation, or winner validation, together with rejection reasons and provenance.

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: S3 object location of the original source record.

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: Physical row number within the original source object.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the original source object.

columns.name: record_id
columns.meaning: Logical record identifier when available.

columns.name: stage
columns.meaning: Pipeline stage at which the record was quarantined.

columns.name: primary_reason
columns.meaning: Primary reason the record failed validation.

columns.name: all_reasons
columns.meaning: Complete set of validation failure reasons associated with the quarantined record.

columns.name: raw_payload
columns.meaning: Preserved raw payload of the rejected physical record.

datasets.title: Curated Research Telemetry Dataset
datasets.purpose: Validated and curated synthetic temperature observation dataset produced by the Lab 2 deterministic curation pipeline.

columns.name: record_id
columns.meaning: Unique logical identifier of the observation record.

columns.name: sensor_id
columns.meaning: Identifier of the sensor that produced the observation.

columns.name: site
columns.meaning: Site associated with the sensor according to the sensor registry.

columns.name: event_time_utc
columns.meaning: UTC timestamp when the observation event occurred.

columns.name: ingest_time_utc
columns.meaning: UTC timestamp when the observation was ingested.

columns.name: temperature_c
columns.meaning: Validated temperature measurement in degrees Celsius.

columns.name: is_late
columns.meaning: Indicates whether the valid observation arrived later than the configured timeliness threshold.

columns.name: source_object
columns.meaning: Original source object from which the observation originated.

columns.name: source_row
columns.meaning: Physical row number of the observation within the original source object.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.meaning: SHA-256 digest of the original source object used for provenance verification.
